cc:Work.dc:title: Shelf - StorageShelf
cc:Work.dc:description:
StorageShelf can be used to store Typetray
This is a simple shelf box.
Created with Boxes.py (https://boxes.hackerspace-bamberg.de/) Command line: boxes StorageShelf --x 100 --sy '60*2' --sh '55*2' --outside 1 --bottom_edge s --top_edge 'Š' --retainer 0 --thickness 3 --burn 0.1 --reference 0 --labels 0 Command line short: boxes StorageShelf --sy --sh --bottom_edge --top_edge --reference --labels
